kjv: leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection
mine: let us leave the elementary doctrine of Christ and go on to maturity
note: teleiotes is maturity (5:14 "the mature"); "perfection" has fed doctrines of sinless perfection.
parapesontas is one of a series of aorist participles describing the same people; the KJV's conditional "if" softens the warning into a hypothesis.
